title: Anyone been forced to take strange tests within Mallworld?
content: Last night I dreamt I was in an area of the mall that looked like half a food court and a bunch of small shops. There was a lot of neon signs. The signs seem to be in Japanese, I think. I was a with a group of people and it seemed like we were all on a tour. A blonde man in a business suit showed up and told us that we were all finally there and it was time to get to business. Right there in front of my eyes, a section of the mall opened up. There was nothing there but a solid grey wall. But when the man pointed towards the direction we were going, the wall vanished with some kind of pixelation effect. Like an old video game. This new wing of the mall had stores with lots of neon. But I couldn't tell what they selling in them. We went outside and got into a limo. The limo didn't drive very far as it took us around a circular path to another building. When we got down the blonde man told us to get inside. I looked back to mall but instead up and above the building. I could see a very tall tower in the distance. Not too far. But close. The area we were in was enclosed. Building on every side. We had come from the mall, but now we were outside the hospital. I don't know what the other buildings were. There was also no way to get out of this place. We entered the building and went through several glass doors and then down a hallway. The man told us to enter a room. We went into the room and found ourselves in what looked like a conference room. A large wooden table was in the middle. At the far back of the room were two smaller rooms. one appeared to be filled with pastries and coffee. the other was like a small waiting room. there was also a small hallway between the two that led to a door. various potted trees were here and there in the room. On one side were large windows that looked out to the other buildings. I could see the mall and I could see the large tower. It was dark, gloomy. But I could see people looking out the windows. they seem to be working in labs or computer rooms. Looking out these windows was impossible. Since outside in the hallway, it appeared there had been other rooms along the way. Yet, here there were windows looking to the outside. The blond man then told us all to sit down. We were all going to be taking tests. He never told us what the tests were. I never found out myself. It was like the dream prevented me from seeing the tests or even remembering them. But he told us he would be leaving us alone for now. He walked out the door and locked it from the outside. We were stuck here. In the center of the table was an old timey radio. We were all angry about being here. Suddenly a man's voice came through the radio and it sounded robotic. It told us that if we wanted to get out we had to pass the tests within the room. It was like an escape room or something. Suddenly we heard a commotion outside in the hallway. The man was yelling at a woman to try and stop them from coming in and killing us. It seemed like there were some kind of military group trying to get to us. the man sent the woman away to deal with them and slow them down. But he still would not let us out. i started to look around the room for these tests but see a thing. we could hear gunfire outside in the hallway and it was getting closer. We were all panicking. There was this beautiful woman sitting several chairs away from me. She had long light brown hair and brown eyes. But she seemed to want to do something about all this, but she couldn't. Like she couldn't move. AT that point I got up and basically yelled "F this". I ran to the hallway in the back and tried to open the door but it was locked. i then noticed something that was not there before. It looked like a podium but with various buttons and what looked like two large rectangular metal plates on the wall above it. The woman came up next to me and we somehow both figured out that we need to make one of plates hot and other cold. I don't remember how we did it but we solved it and opened the back door. But that's when the blonde man came back and congratulated us for solving the first puzzle. Well he congratulated me and the woman. The others were just confused. The man told us the attack was fake. It was just their way of making us scared. They were testing us to see how we would deal under pressure and fear. Then he said he was leaving again. He went out the door and locked it and wished us good luck in solving the next test. That's when I looked around the room again and noticed it had changed. the two rooms at the far back were now in a different location. A voice on the radio told us that this time around the threat was real and if we didn't solve the test some of us would be killed and the rest would stay there forever. Once again I decided to look for some kind of clues. I went into the pastry room...nothing. Then I went into the small lobby. There was a safe there with a large dial on it. It was high up on a red painted wall. It was the only red wall in the whole place. I stepped on a sofa to reach the safe. But I didn't know how to open it. Once more the woman that helped me tried to help me again. And again we found the answer. We found the combination for the safe. But how? I don't remember. It was as if it wasn't in the dream. Suddenly a voice on the radio said we only had 5 minutes left to solve the test. One of the other people sitting down ran over to me and grabbed it and took it to the safe. everyone else ran to the safe too. The woman and I stayed outside the room watching them go crazy trying to open this safe. this tiny room had small windows that allowed us to see inside. they were fighting just to open it. The voice on the radio said we had just a few seconds left. then the people got the safe open. inside they found a note. I didn't read it. I was nowhere near the note. But they all read it and looked scared. The door to the room shut and locked up. Then the people rushed to it to try and get out. the door wouldn't open. After a while the people all fell to the floor. WTH? The blonde man came back in and congratulated us again. According to him, we had solved the test and that we had figured out that the answer was to kill the other people. I didn't understand what this guy was saying. It made no sense. I mean it's a dream right. But he told us that we could leave. That was enough to let him know what he needed. Then he told us they do these tests to everyone. he then said that the people that died didn't really die. that they would just come back and fail again and again. he then threatened our lives if we didn't get out of the building that very moment. So the woman and I left. When I got outside again, there was no sign of the woman anywhere. She was gone. I was left alone and I had no idea where to go. I saw what looked like an entrance and beyond that I could see what looked like a flea market. it ws kind of dark in there. I think I started to head towards the direction of the mall. But I could still see the huge tower up above. There were also dark clouds in the distance and what looked like what every one calls the tsunami. But I recently saw a nature show about weather and maybe it's not a tsunami but something called a roll cloud. anyway I woke up when I started to head towards the mall entrance. I don't think it was there anymore but like I said I woke up and never got to get there.
